name: Tanya and a little magic
source:
Another short story with Tanya from Youjo Senki. This time with a little hypnosis Ainz and Kazuma made her act like a perfect little slut.

[From [url=https://little-huntress-team.itch.io/tanya-and-a-little-magic]Itch.io[/url]]
